_comment: Translation config (see docs/human-review-queue.md Config & env). Keys: base_url ("" primary env TRANSLATE_BASE_URL → fallback QMD_OPENAI_BASE_URL), reviewer_base_url ("" → inherits base_url; env TRANSLATE_REVIEWER_BASE_URL overrides), api_key_env (env var name, default TRANSLATE_API_KEY → fallback QMD_OPENAI_API_KEY), model (minimax-m2.7), reviewer_model (kimi-k2.7), chunk_chars (6000 heading→paragraph, qmd-aligned), review_sample (0.2), glossary_path (data/domain_terms/glossary.csv), fix_rounds (3 — max LLM repair rounds per doc after QA failures, 0=disable). --mock bypasses base_url.
